newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-SCOTLAND RECALL FORMER LEAGUE PLAYER TAIT.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SCOTLAND RECALL FORMER LEAGUE PLAYER TAIT.

text.p: Alan Tait is set to return to Scotland's rugby union side after a nine-year gap when they face Ireland in the Five Nations' championship at Murrayfield on March 1.

Centre Tait, 32, who switched back from rugby league to join Newcastle this season, has been included in a 21-man Scotland squad which shows only minor changes following the record 41-13 thrashing by England at Twickenham this month.
Twickenham try-scorer Ronnie Eriksson and Derek Stark are replaced by Tait and Cameron Glasgow, with replacement Scott Hastings also dropping out in favour of club colleague Duncan Hodge.
Backs - Rowen Shepherd, Tony Stanger, Alan Tait, Cameron Glasgow, Kenny Logan, Duncan Hodge, Gregor Townsend, Craig Chalmers, Bryan Redpath, Gary Armstrong.
Forward - Rob Wainwright (captain), Ian Smith, Peter Walton, Andy Reed, Doddie Weir, Shade Munro, Mattie Stewart, Graham Ellis, Steve Brotherstone, Tom Smith, David Hilton.
